title: Isolation precautions

findings.where: src/explainer.jsx — p.dg-caption aria-live="polite" and the audio playback effect; narrated versions of steps standard through transport
findings.title: Narration and screen-reader announcements can speak over each other
findings.problem: The caption remains a live region while recorded narration plays. Advancing a step updates that caption and starts the next audio clip, allowing duplicate or competing speech. The screenshots cannot demonstrate this, and screen-reader playback was not supplied for verification.
findings.fix: Disable automatic caption live-region announcements when recorded narration is active. Keep captions and diagram descriptions available for manual reading, and test step advancement with VoiceOver and NVDA.

assessment: No confirmed clinical or pictured-label errors in the isolation content. One accessibility defect remains in narrated playback.
